summary: @or-sdk/qna preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The `preinstall` hook in package.json runs `node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` is an obfuscator.io-style wrapper (hex-named `_0x...` identifiers, per-function string-lookup tables) that downloads the Bun runtime binary (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, unpacks it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'])`. The invoked sibling `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated JavaScript blob shipped in the tarball, using a shuffled global string/number array, array-rotation decoder (`WV8StW`), and mangled identifiers, making its behavior opaque. The payload is executed under the freshly-downloaded Bun runtime rather than Node, which bypasses Node-based install-time sandboxes and scanners. The package advertises itself as a QnA SDK; nothing about that stated purpose requires downloading a separate JavaScript runtime at install to execute an unreadable local blob. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: install-time execution of obfuscated code via an alien runtime, fired automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
